genuine.heading: We only sell what we'd trust on our own phones.
genuine.body: Grey-market accessories fail quietly — a cable that overheats, a case that doesn't quite fit, earbuds that stop pairing after a month. Every item at Tony Apple comes sealed from an authorised distributor, and we check the serial with you before you pay.
